title: Grass=Random Item
description: Break grass blocks to receive a random block every time! Perfect for chaotic survival, challenge runs, and randomizer gameplay.
body:
**Minecraft But Grass Drops a Random Block** is a simple datapack that makes every grass block drop a completely random block when broken.

Every time you break a grass block, you'll receive a random block from Minecraft, making survival much more unpredictable and fun. You might get common building blocks, rare materials, or something completely unexpected!

### Features

* 🌱 Grass blocks drop a random block.
* 🎲 Random results every time.
* 🧱 Includes blocks from across the game.
* ✅ Multiplayer compatible.
* 📦 Easy to install—just place the datapack in your world's `datapacks` folder.

Perfect for challenge runs, randomizer worlds, or just adding some chaos to your survival experience!
